purpose: Retrospective latest-vintage sensitivity study; not certified real-time forecast accuracy
target: Next retained source-date observation, conditional on its date; gaps <=14 days; not certified next official decision
origin: 00:00 Asia/Beirut on target source date; prior target source date assumed available next local day
market_availability: Part 3 conservative assumed release lags, latest captured editions; strict evaluation separately fails closed
excluded: 2019-09 through 2023-05-11: subsidy/FX transitions without full FX history. 2025-05-29 onward: fiscal breaks without verified component history or sufficient regime-specific official targets.
selection: Mean absolute validation error; family/window/lag frozen before final evaluation; expanding coefficients may use only earlier targets. No selection by final-test error.
ecm_gate: Training only: at least 60 consecutive weekly observations; both log levels compatible with I(1), differences stationary, Engle-Granger rejects no cointegration at 5%; no interpolated/filled prices.
break_analysis: Policy-defined research boundaries; training-only CUSUM diagnostic, no automatically fitted full-sample break dates
